### Daily Disciples Devotional - January 2
Author: Daily Disciples
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-january-2-11563076.html
Passage: Romans 12:1-2
Points:
- Worldly entertainment and advertising continually shape our thinking often without us realizing it.
- Lingering worldly thoughts compound over time and eventually surface in our outward habits and behavior.
- Christians must actively guard their thought life by intentionally filtering out negative influences.
- Presenting our bodies and minds as sacrifices means substituting worldly noise with praise and worship.
- Continual mental renewal through prayer and God's power brings peace, joy, and lasting life transformation.
